xray_channel_projection — TOMOGRAPHY spectral_xray op

• Data kinds: images → images

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.xray_channel_projection(thickness, materials_list=('MUSCLE_ICRU44',), channels=None, photons_per_pixel: 'float' = 100000.0, noise: 'bool' = True, seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import dualxray; dualxray.xray_channel_projection(thickness, materials_list=('MUSCLE_ICRU44',), channels=None, photons_per_pixel: 'float' = 100000.0, noise: 'bool' = True, seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opstomography.get("xray_channel_projection"))

• Return value through the ledger: fullseye.ledger.xray_channel_projection(...) returns only the declared out type images (the underlying function also returns auxiliary values). When you need what was dropped, use fullseye.ledger.xray_channel_projection.raw(...) or call dualxray.xray_channel_projection directly.

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Thickness map per material → an image of the signal in each channel (C, H, W).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

thickness: (M, H, W)、単位 cm(materials_list の材料ごとに 1 枚、重なりは足し算 = 細いビームの Beer–Lambert)。photons_per_pixel: 1 画素に入射する光子の数(全エネルギー、検出器の前)。計数(counting)のチャネルは平均 n₀ Σ W e^{−μt} の Poisson 標本(photoncount.photon_sample、チャネルごとに seed から決まる別の乱数列)。積分型(integrating)は平均と分散 Σ W E² e^{−μt} のガウス(複合 Poisson の近似)。noise=False は平均そのもの。空き(厚み 0)の平均は channels から決まるので、分解の op は同じ channels と photons_per_pixel を受けて自分で計算する(白の撮影を別に渡すこともできる)。
